items.title: An immersion with quasi-compact source or reduced source is an open immersion onto a dense open of its scheme theoretic image
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Algebraic Spaces)
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-morphisms.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an immersion h : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over S with Z -> X quasi-compact or Z reduced, the morphism Z -> Zbar to the scheme theoretic image is an open immersion identifying Z with a scheme theoretically dense open subspace of Zbar, and Z is even topologically dense in Zbar (source lines 3568-3577). The proof observes that in both cases the formation of Zbar commutes with etale localization, using the quasi-compact and the reduced statements respectively, and then invokes the corresponding lemma for schemes.
